organization.name: Bluethroat Labs
organization.summary: Research-led security firm for blockchain protocols, founded by Rahul Saxena per the proposal. Its site lists vulnerability writeups (called Reveries), a public TEE Security Handbook and an attestation section with testimonials, and has a banner that claims an Immunefi 90-day leaderboard position as of 6 November 2026 (not checked here). The Handbook source repository saxenism/Bluethroat-labs was created 2026-01-16. The proposal says the Handbook is self-funded. Public team size: Not found in public sources.

claims.claim: The public Handbook already covers platform explanations, a Nitro workflow, failure patterns and layered defenses.
claims.method: The page returns HTTP 200 and its navigation lists AWS Nitro System, AWS Nitro Enclaves, dstack, TEE attacks categorisation, Dumb ways to get rekt w/ TEEs and Layers of security for protocols building with TEEs. Content accuracy was not reviewed.

claims.claim: The Handbook repository is public and active.
claims.method: GitHub API: MIT license, created 2026-01-16, last push 2026-11-25, 0 stars, no releases. The repository description is only Project.

claims.claim: A critical advisory for CVE-2026-22696 exists for dcap-qvl.
claims.method: The advisory exists, is rated critical, published 2026-01-26 and names dcap-qvl and @phala/dcap-qvl packages. The advisory lists no credits.

Applicant-reported. The advisory lists no credits, and Phala's post credits Rahul Saxena (Bluethroat Labs) for issues in the attestation pipeline without naming this CVE. The finder attribution rests on the Bluethroat writeup.

claims.claim: Phala publicly credits Rahul and Bluethroat for attestation-pipeline research.
claims.method: The post dated 2026-02-10 says independent security researcher Rahul Saxena (Bluethroat Labs) identified issues in January 2026 and that fixes were deployed.

claims.claim: Taiko's postmortem documents a debug-policy gap.
claims.method: The post dated 2026-07-23 says an attestation check failed to reject a prover running in debug mode, alongside an exposed signing key, and describes about USD 1.75 million withdrawn.

claims.claim: Bluethroat ranks #4 on the Immunefi 90-day leaderboard.
claims.method: The site banner states the ranking as of 6 November 2026. The Immunefi leaderboard page was not checked here.

claims.claim: Bluethroat has research involving Secret Network and Phala/dstack disclosures.
claims.method: The Phala side is confirmed by Phala's post. The Secret Network work rests on Bluethroat's own writeups and testimonials. No Secret Network advisory was checked.

claims.claim: A Docusaurus migration is planned for 2026-09-16 and the Handbook is self-funded.
claims.method: The migration date has passed and the current site is labelled v0.4. Whether the migration happened was not determined. Funding status rests on the proposal statement alone.

claims.claim: At least 4 chapters, 4 checklists and 4 runnable example collections will be delivered, with 6 independent adopting teams.
claims.method: Future deliverables. No adopters are claimed as committed.
